summary: Tested CRM bug fixes: (1) Industry field visibility in edit dialog and (2) CRM dropdown counter updates. Both bugs are fixed. Found and fixed backend issue - 'industry' was not in allowed_fields list for lead updates.

industry_field_in_edit_dialog.details: Industry field visible at lines 1701-1714 in LeadOutreachSection.js. Dropdown opens correctly with all industry options. Selection works. Fixed Radix SelectItem value='' bug by using value='none'.

industry_save_persistence.details: Industry value now saves correctly. Backend fix: added 'industry' to allowed_fields in /app/backend/routers/crm.py line 260.

crm_dropdown_counters.details: useEffect on line 82-86 in ClientEngagementPage.js calls fetchStats when navigating within CRM sections. Counters show: Outreach (6), Inbound (11), Clients (3).

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Industry field was not being saved when updating leads - field was missing from allowed_fields whitelist
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added 'industry' to allowed_fields list in update_lead function at line 260

seed_data_creation: Set industry='Retail' on lead 'Elizabeth Diaz - Test' during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM lead edit dialog Industry field is working. Backend allowed_fields list was missing 'industry' - now fixed. CRM dropdown counters refresh on navigation via useEffect. The total badge (17) in CRM tab header = Outreach (6) + Inbound (11).
